_ordering_rationale: Regulated Industries en tete (plus gros segment FY25, croissance acquisitions Pii/Mikros). Intelligent Infrastructure ensuite (hero AI/cloud, croissance hypercroissance). CLDC dernier (en contraction post-cession Mobility).
_notes: JBL a reorganise ses segments le 1er sept 2024 (FY25). Historique avant FY23 indisponible sous cette presentation. Segments precedents (EMS/DMS) ne sont pas reconciliables.

kpis.signal: Plus gros segment FY25 (~37.6% CA), boost acquisitions Pii (pharma) + Mikros (cooling)
kpis.description_fr: CA Regulated Industries (auto/transport, healthcare/packaging, renewables/energy infrastructure). Plus gros segment FY25 ~37.6% du CA, ~5% marge segment income.
kpis.description_en: Regulated Industries revenue (auto/transport, healthcare/packaging, renewables/energy infra). Largest FY25 segment ~37.6% of revenue, ~5% segment income margin.

kpis.signal: Hero segment FY25, croissance +34% portee par AI infrastructure (cloud, data center)
kpis.description_fr: CA Intelligent Infrastructure (AI infra, cloud data center, capital equipment, networking). Segment hero FY25, croissance dopee par AI/data center buildout.
kpis.description_en: Intelligent Infrastructure revenue (AI infra, cloud data center, capital equipment, networking). FY25 hero segment, AI/data center buildout-driven growth.

kpis.signal: En forte contraction post-cession Mobility Business (dec. 2023), segment en repositionnement
kpis.description_fr: CA Connected Living and Digital Commerce. En forte contraction depuis FY23 suite cession Mobility Business (dec. 2023, ~$1.2 Mds actifs cedes, gain $942M).
kpis.description_en: Connected Living and Digital Commerce revenue. Strong contraction since FY23 after Mobility Business divestiture (Dec 2023, ~$1.2B assets divested, $942M gain).

kpis.signal: Marge segment 5.4%, profitabilite amelioree porte par mix AI infra
kpis.description_fr: Segment income II FY25 $664M, marge 5.4%. Plus grosse contribution profit segments FY25 (~41% du segment income total $1,620M).
kpis.description_en: II FY25 segment income $664M, 5.4% margin. Largest FY25 segment profit contributor (~41% of $1,620M total segment income).

kpis.signal: Pic FY24 ($296M) lie au plan post-cession Mobility, en normalisation FY25
kpis.description_fr: Charges restructuration, licenciement et couts associes. Pic FY24 lie au plan post-cession Mobility Business, normalisation engagee FY25.
kpis.description_en: Restructuring, severance and related charges. FY24 peak tied to post-Mobility divestiture plan, normalization underway FY25.
